sources.title: MiMo-V2.6 | Xiaomi
sources.snippet: Today, we are releasing and open-sourcing the MiMo-V2.6 series. This marks a key step in our exploration of the RSI path: scaling RL compute on verifiable, complex tasks, so the model can continuously expand its capability frontier through exploration and feedback. sources.snippet: MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B is a 9B agentic model developed by Xiaomi MiMo through supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-9B on MiMo-generated data. It covers coding, general-purpose agent tasks, visual coding, and cybersecurity. We release this SFT checkpoint as a starting point for open research in agentic reinforcement learning.
